instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Lay out a diagram of boxes and arrows so few arrows cross, and give me the positions, the arrow routes, how many arrows cross and a picture of it as SVG", and give it nodes; edges.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:lay-out-a-diagram and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Takes the boxes (an id, and optionally a label, a size, a lane and a style) and the arrows between them (from, to, an optional id and label).
